curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: identify straight lines in different situations

mission.title: identify straight lines in different situations

interactions.prompt: Look at the two lines. Tap the straight line.

choices.label: Straight line
choices.accessibleDescription: a line that goes in one direction without bending

interactions.feedback: Yes! A straight line does not bend.
interactions.retryHint: Find the line that goes in one direction without turning.

interactions.prompt: A ruler has a straight edge. Tap the ruler.

choices.label: Banana
choices.accessibleDescription: a banana that bends in a curve

choices.label: Ruler
choices.accessibleDescription: a ruler with a straight long edge

choices.label: Rainbow
choices.accessibleDescription: a rainbow curved like an arch

interactions.feedback: Great! The long edge of a ruler is straight.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the tool used for measuring. Its edge does not bend.

interactions.prompt: Put the straight things in the Straight box.

categories.label: Not straight
categories.accessibleDescription: objects with a line that bends

interactions.tapAlternative: Tap an item, then tap Straight or Not straight.
interactions.feedback: Well done! Pencils and fence rails show straight lines.
interactions.retryHint: A straight line does not bend. Look at each item carefully.

interactions.prompt: At school, which edge is straight? Tap it.

choices.label: Ball edge
choices.accessibleDescription: the round edge of a ball

choices.label: Book edge
choices.accessibleDescription: a straight edge of a book

choices.label: Rope loop
choices.accessibleDescription: a rope bent into a loop

interactions.feedback: Correct! The edge of a book is straight.
interactions.retryHint: Look for the edge that does not turn or bend.

interactions.prompt: On the way home, sort the things by their lines.

items.label: Window frame
items.accessibleDescription: a window frame with straight sides

interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a thing, then tap Straight or Not straight.
interactions.feedback: Excellent sorting! Road markings and window frames have straight lines.
interactions.retryHint: Straight lines keep going without bending.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Which item has a straight line? Tap it.

choices.label: Stick
choices.accessibleDescription: a straight stick lying on the ground

interactions.feedback: You did it! A straight stick shows a straight line.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the item that goes straight without bending.
